businesses.business: online career marketplaces for technology professionals

offering_description.value: Operates online career sites and job boards, mainly Dice for technology professionals and ClearanceJobs for security-cleared professionals. Employers and recruiters pay for job postings and resume database access to find specialized talent, and candidates use the sites to find jobs.

primary_products.value: online job boards; recruitment subscriptions; resume database access; employer branding and advertising products

primary_services.value: recruitment marketing; candidate sourcing; job posting services; career events and content

customer_segment.value: B2B: employers, staffing firms and recruiters hiring technology and security-cleared talent; B2C: technology and security-cleared job seekers using the sites, mostly free

end_markets.value: technology; defense and government contracting; intelligence; recruitment and staffing

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring packages for job postings and resume database access; advertising: employer branding and recruitment advertising; service fees: event and sourcing services

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: operates online job marketplaces connecting employers and recruiters with candidates

geography_served.value: global: Primarily United States, with some presence in Europe and Asia via Dice

specialization.value: related lines: Dice tech careers site and ClearanceJobs cleared-professional job site, both niche recruiting marketplaces

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to employers and recruiters; online: self-service purchase and candidate access via websites and apps

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy rules such as CCPA and GDPR, employment advertising and anti-discrimination rules

notes: Not fully certain of current brand lineup; eFinancialCareers was sold and is excluded.
